items.title: Howard Alden interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997
items.q: Nicholas Payton is playing just so great these days too.

ctx.x: Well it was just a question for fun.

Yeah, I know, I’m taking it very seriously. But Ruby Braff is one of my favorite players, on the other hand Nicholas Payton is playing just so great these days too. So I’d have an A and B band or something.
Have you been in the role of a leader?
